root_cause: OwnerReadContextMiddleware set request_read_cache for the ASGI lifespan scope; lifespan-created tasks inherited one process-lifetime cache so cached_owner_call froze paper worker sessions.
fixes: OwnerReadContextMiddleware only sets authorization/selected_tenant/request_read_cache for http and websocket scopes; other scopes pass through unchanged.
personas.service._reconcile_persona_provisioning_pass wraps each background pass in a fresh _RequestReadCache (shared within a pass, never across passes).

lifespan_task_audit.note: grep: no cached_owner_call/shared_persona_directory_list/owner_reads use in auth/service.py or core/lifespan.py; unaffected, and now sees cache=None regardless.
operates on the durable command store; any indirect owner read now sees request_read_cache=None (uncached, always fresh) because the middleware no longer sets it for lifespan.
downstream_health_monitor.py has no references to cached_owner_call, shared_persona_directory_list or owner_reads; unaffected, and lifespan context now carries no cache.
was stale forever; fixed by middleware change plus a per-pass fresh scope.

tests: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_owner_read_context_lifespan.py (lifespan sees None; fails on dev; per-request isolation/dedupe; loop sees fresh data each pass)
limitations: The background-loop regression test patches _reconcile_persona_provisioning_once with a cached_owner_call reader rather than driving the full fleet-state/paper_running pipeline; hosted canary by operator still required.
